notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/2a22d6a237cff9bf5dfa35b88fc0af3b368b2b62.gif[/img]

[h1]From Transylvania With Love[/h1]
Completed! This time, you have to find 20 items (and so far it’s my favourite level!).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/aa25e1c234efba19f68100666756d531dc7cd463.gif[/img]

[h1]Vikings’ Adventures[/h1]
The background is ready! Now the artist is working on the characters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/e15ede442f5f19ea2ddd107e8e5fa51eba3cd4a7.gif[/img]

[h1]Wild West[/h1]
Another group of artists almost finished the Wild West. Now we are animating the characters and hope to put it all together soon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/c4aaa89e6bd7e38a1e1fbd2bc04c428c9c0766ba.jpg[/img]

At this moment we use 2 art teams to finish the game as soon as possible. Wild West is created by the same artists as Sci-Fi level ("In A Black Hole Far Away"), so it looks and feels a bit different but still great. Maybe we will give you a taste of it in a further demo update :) 

And we hope we can find some more awesome artists to work on PLT expansion after release to make it more diverse.

[h1]Updated demo[/h1]
Demo has now uncensored (Adults Only 18+) mode, music can be muted, improved stability on some video cards.

[h1]Yes, Master![/h1]
Meanwhile, ktulhusolutions will be a publisher for the game [b]Yes, Master![/b]
It’s an erotic visual novel mixed with a point-and-click adventure.

[b]Yes, Master![/b] will be available for free.
Without censorship. For adult players only.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090900/Yes_Master/

Hugs for everyone!

tags.feature: Demo has now uncensored (Adults Only 18+) mode, music can be muted, improved stability on some video cards.

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
[h1]Spring fling[/h1] 
Hello everyone, work is in progress!
Sci-fi level [b]"In a Black Hole Far Far Away"[/b] is completed. Pretty complex and twisted, huh.. It won’t be easy to save the space princess from lusty reptilians  :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/83877cbeb15d1fa77aa48322633b0a83dd06704e.jpg[/img]

Vampires is also almost done, but it sill needs some final touches and sound effects.

[h1]Wild West[/h1]
Our answer to Red Dead Redemption! We are filling the level with details and characters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/fc1335d4fcf7691137b0f77719205f81f77f7e91.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/1aee13e720645148bc6d9231b8d23ab57afa1c68.jpg[/img]

Any suggestions how to name it? Leave  your comments below!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/903f69fcb124412b6afcf833564ceca53ef31a43.jpg[/img]

[h1]Extra Content[/h1]
Meanwhile, we also work on materials that will be available in the [b]Founders Edition[/b]. So far it’s a book with illustrations and a bunch of wallpapers. Maybe we can think up something else.

Wallpaper samples:
https://imgur.com/0i6TJXA    (NSFW)
https://imgur.com/d3ndxSS

[h1]Demo, feedback, discord[/h1]
Thanks for your feedback! We have updated the demo to fix some issues and add “Safe For Work” mode (so you can post videos on youtube if you want to). But still not sure if the full game will have this mode.

Join us on discord server -  [url=https://discord.gg/6umfvv7]https://discord.gg/6umfvv7[/url]
We are working closely with [b]Lesson Of Passion[/b] team for a long time, so we decided to have a common server.  More fun!

See you!

tags.feature: We have updated the demo to fix some issues and add “Safe For Work” mode (so you can post videos on youtube if you want to).

notes.title: Perky Little Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Demo is here![/h1]
Demo is available on [b]Perky Little Things[/b] store page for PC, Mac and Linux.
It contains initial CHRISTMAS EVE and two brand new levels! Third level will be unlocked only after the second one is completed (sic).

[h1]“Outlines” menu option[/h1]
This is off by default. We prefer to have this option enabled, but on some video cards it makes characters disappear or look weird. Hopefully we can make it more stable later.

[h1]Censorship[/h1]
Suddenly Valve makes us to set “Adults Only” rating for the demo (and we hoped for “Mature 17”). Anyway, it means we don’t need any extra DLC and we can just make censorship optional (in the main release).

[h1]Your feedback[/h1]
It’s like an “Early Access” for us, so our main goal is to get *as much feedback* as we can. 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/811890/discussions/0/1842440600619709730/]Please share your thoughts, issues or suggestions  here.[/url]

Thank you!
It's time to plug it in!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/10adc0920fca0fe1215c15376e181930f9c5667f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[h1]Slowly but surely[/h1]

Hello! The development process is still in progress, although not as fast as we would like. Also it was decided to rethink the basic concept of the game a bit to make it more exciting.

Good news - we try to work with one more talanted artist, who managed to follow the art style. It will speed us up greatly in case of success. The music for intro and the “School of Magic” is also ready, it suits the game perfectly :)

Anyway, we hope autumn will be more productive, and we will be able to share news more often.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/3e33c5e310cd073ee8d0a4972aaded4454c16dd2.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay changes, new UI[/h1]
Initially, a very simple game mechanics was planned. There are 10 items at each level  that you need to find, and then hand them out to 10 different characters.

The problem was that 10 items were played at a large level ...  a bit empty. So we decided to make more items, some of which will be initially blocked. Such items become available only by use of other items, forming a kind of action "chains".

We also had to change the interface and some logic, but it's getting much better! :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/3e9559dedfcb8d349d990ddd70b9949a5cbc8853.jpg[/img]

Not all items are visible now in UI (to save a screen space), but only a part that you can "scroll through".

[h1]Pirates of Southern Seas[/h1]
The level is filling with characters. Basically they are pirates :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/1681abfd31bf0d9388e2ba86ac20d056106348fc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/2b8a503a0dc69f986f335f0bc997b8cd7d228644.jpg[/img]
[h1]Story Comic[/h1]
Games are based either on mechanics or story. And although we usually prefer the second option, this time the story is not so important. But we don’t  want to completely ignore the plot, so we have one! 

The story will be in the form of a comic, but it’s not yet decided if it will be animated it or not.

The main character is a beginner Cupid. Cupids should give people love and happiness in all its forms. The hero does not have any supernatural skills due to lack of experience. To get started, the angel mentor advises simply "to finish the picture," in small strokes to push people to happiness.


[h1]School of Magic is ready![/h1]
The location is approximately 6000 by 4000 pixels. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mrr0t9C.gif[/img]

We still need to choose a musical background, but the author of the music theme for “Christmas Eve in Metropolis” kindly agreed to continue cooperation with us and write music for the whole game. It is assumed that each level will have its own music.
Meanwhile we begin to draw and animate the next level - "Pirates of southern seas"!

[h1]New mechanics[/h1]
In addition to searching for items and characters, there will be a search for "secrets" at each level. These are certain areas in the location, which you have to poke several times with your mouse to get hidden scenes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/797b62c0948d27075bfa814243086041e1048cb0.gif[/img]

Some rooms can become misted and you need to clean it to get a better view :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/2d361c3d8be7dea3f60b0d2b1f3a5b6922768fb7.gif[/img]

We will try to diversify the gameplay with such things.
Have any fun ideas? - Write it in the comments!

[h1]Tips[/h1]
Yes, it was the missing part in Christmas Eve and now we have it :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/4e81a8742553331535939d150e4183dd8e2f130d.jpg[/img]

The button is available after cool down timer,  and when pressed - the camera moves to the next item or character. The zoom of the camera also became more convenient.

Stay with us! All for now!
